issues.title: 20-variable smoke treats zero atom rows as compiler failure
issues.defect: Smoke requires V551 `atom_rows > 0` and also rejects zero atom rows in V552 summary paths.
issues.consequence: The acceptance harness would fail the new valid no-evidence semantics even after compilers are corrected.
issues.required: Gate smoke on run integrity + typed evidence state + operation-specific expected sufficiency, not blanket row count.
tests: Valid zero-promotable fixture passes integrity smoke with explicit evidence state.

issues.title: Section85 authority hardcodes nonzero V551 atom rows for pass
issues.defect: Section85 currently declares the required V551 relation-evidence artifact must have nonzero rows to pass.
issues.evidence: Current main Section85 authority file SHA recorded in hash inventory; hostile pass found literal nonzero requirement.
issues.consequence: Acceptance authority would invalidate a correct typed zero-evidence run.
issues.required: Version/replace the Section85 rule with artifact integrity + producer run integrity + typed evidence status.
tests: Zero-promotable valid fixture satisfies revised Section85 integrity rule.

issues.title: Section85 runners consume obsolete V551J readiness booleans
issues.defect: Current Section85 runners read old V551J ready/not-ready boolean semantics that conflate packet cardinality and compiler integrity.
issues.consequence: Even after V551J migration, Section85 can re-impose the old state model.
issues.required: Migrate to new V551J run-integrity/evidence/permission fields in the same acceptance change set.
tests: All-certified, review-only, and no-joint-evidence fixtures are classified distinctly.

issues.title: Extraction audits conflate atom count with certified run/evidence sufficiency
issues.defect: Extraction auditing currently uses V551 atom count as a proxy for certified output/usefulness rather than distinguishing valid zero-promotable runs from failed runs.
issues.consequence: Diagnostic reports can declare healthy no-evidence scopes broken or obscure repair-only outcomes.
issues.required: Report run integrity, candidate/promotable/nonpromotable counts and coverage status separately.
tests: Audit explicitly labels valid zero-promotable vs compiler failure.
